title: EGS Recursive Fidelity Test (ERFT) · Version Four — Engine Grammar Scoreboard
honestyBoundary: ERFT V4 is a controlled, falsifiable recursive-fidelity protocol: nest partitions plus Infinite Octaves engine fixtures (Φ_EGS, clutch Δ, k/81, octaves 01–99, odd-prime vaults, structural 2). Application companion — not ENGINE_SHELF pin. Does not assume Φ wins, does not claim CODATA replacement or AGI safety. Suite pass = protocol integrity; empirical Φ advantage may fail.

preRegisteredHypothesis.claim: If Φ_EGS reduces cumulative recursive fidelity drift vs matched controls, the advantage must appear across domains, mechanisms, decoy constants, and held-out series — without assuming Φ a priori.
win_requires: lower cumulative RFD vs baseline at depth N
survives decoy constants (√2, e, blind ladder)
preRegisteredHypothesis.suite_pass_means: Protocol executed reproducibly with locked arms/mechanisms/metrics — NOT that Φ won.
preRegisteredHypothesis.anti_baseline_bias: Baseline (c=1) must not inherit least-drift by construction via milder coarsening or null transforms.

experiments.title: Anti-baseline-bias construction locks (V3 nest grammar)
experiments.interpretation: Fails if c=1 is still the mildest dial or if scaling/weighting are null transforms — the V1 construction bug.
experiments.honesty: Anti-bias lock ≠ Φ win. Empirical outcomes still free to null.

experiments.title: Nest-ratio grammar lock (V3 · models RSI partition, not sin(c))
experiments.interpretation: Φ satisfies whole:part ≈ part:remainder; baseline is dyadic 1:1; decoys use 1/c partition without V2 arbitrary phase.
experiments.honesty: Grammar lock ≠ Φ empirical win on fixtures.

experiments.title: Infinite Octaves engine fixture lock (clutch · k/81 · octaves · prime vaults)
experiments.interpretation: Lags/blocks derive from catalog engine grammar (Planck–1.6 clutch Δ, 81-register scale, digit×octave 01–99, odd-prime vaults, structural 2 baseline) — not V3-only nest without octaves.
experiments.honesty: Engine fixture lock ≠ ENGINE_SHELF pin or CODATA proof.

experiments.title: Five-arm matched recursion (baseline · Φ · √2 · e · random)
experiments.interpretation: Identical recursion/evaluator; only nest ratio c differs. Scoreboard reports mechanism-class winners — suite pass does not crown Φ.
experiments.honesty: Proxy fixtures; V3 nest grammar replaces V2 sin geometry.

experiments.title: Blind constant ladder (φ unlabeled · mean RFD over all mechanisms)
experiments.interpretation: If φ repeatedly lands near minimum drift across domains, evidence strengthens; V1 records rank without special-casing.
experiments.honesty: Single-series blind ladder is illustrative; multi-domain aggregation is the real test.

experiments.title: Continuous Drift(c) sweep with train/hold split (all mechanisms)
experiments.interpretation: Pronounced minimum near φ on held-out kinds would be interesting; absence falsifies the strong claim for this mechanism/fixture set.
experiments.honesty: Sweep minima are fixture-relative; do not promote to CODATA.

experiments.title: Drift slope contrast (power-law RFD ≈ a n^b)
experiments.interpretation: Hypothesis interest is whether φ changes error-accumulation exponent — not only generation-1 RMSE.
experiments.honesty: Power-law fit is a pre-registered summary, not proof of a bounded attractor.
